items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop Weekender Tote Bag
items.alt: Navy weekender tote printed edge to edge with white sailboats on teal waves, resting on the sand beside a towel and straw hat at Wrightsville Beach, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A large printed weekender tote with a navy sloop pattern wrapped around the body and bottom. A Wrightsville Beach bag for beach weekends on the Carolina coast.
facts: 24 x 13 in with a T bottom
100% spun polyester exterior, black cotton blend lining, spot clean
Sailboat pattern printed edge to edge around the body and bottom, not embroidered
